newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered eases on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered eases on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered Plc eased on profit-taking on Wednesday after the recent rally that carried shares to record peaks during the past two sessions, dealers said.
By 1040 GMT, the shares were down 17-1/2p to 870, while the rest of the sector was narrowly mixed.
Dealers said the recent advance -- which saw the share price rise by more than 15 percent from February 25 to March 4, when they settled at a record -- was largely sparked by a stock shortage.
"Today we're seeing some profit-taking and we're getting some stock back in the market" said one market maker. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
